NOTE THE THERMAL SPREAD before reading this as a regression: today's admissible pairs at identical-or-heavier content span 30.74 -> 34.34 (~3.5 ms) with the machine's warmth, and this pair sits at the warm end after a full day of load; the change itself is a two-draw REMOVAL plus CPU-side retiming. Budget against max, not a single baseline. max 35.0 held (tight: ~2% over baseline at the warm end) — the carried levers (haze trim, sprite->instanced migration; 3-5 ms) are the recovery path and should land BEFORE new ch1 spend.
